subject: E-Commerce
title: The Dopamine Loop
description: A 60-second lesson on The Dopamine Loop.

hook.text: Online shopping triggers the same brain chemical as gambling. The anticipation of a package releases dopamine.

buildup.text: Dopamine spikes not when you receive the item, but when you click 'Buy.' The purchase itself is the reward.

discovery.text: Tracking notifications extend the dopamine loop. Each update—shipped, in transit, delivered—gives a small hit.

twist.text: Many buyers feel a letdown after delivery. The excitement was in anticipation, not the product itself.

climax.text: E-commerce is designed around dopamine. One-click buy, fast shipping, and tracking all exploit brain chemistry.

punchline.text: The buy button, not the box, gives the rush. Shopping is dopamine engineering.

quiz.question: When does dopamine peak during online shopping?
